items.name: card-stack
items.title: Card Stack
items.description: Scroll-driven sticky card stack with GSAP ScrollTrigger. Nest <motion-card-stack-item> elements inside.

items.name: infinite-physics-gallery
items.title: Infinite Physics Gallery
items.description: Infinite 2-D draggable grid with physics-based momentum, edge scrolling, and support for mixed image/video cells. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

items.name: logo-carousel
items.title: Logo Carousel
items.description: Grid of logos that cycles through items with a blurred vertical swap animation. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

items.name: magnetic
items.title: Magnetic
items.description: Native custom element with GSAP-powered magnetic hover motion and no Lit dependency.

items.name: magnetic-lit
items.title: Magnetic (Lit)
items.description: Framework-agnostic <motion-magnetic> Custom Element with spring physics, powered by Lit and GSAP.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: Scroll-velocity-boosted infinite marquee. Vanilla Custom Element — no Lit dependency.

items.name: progressive-blur
items.title: Progressive Blur
items.description: Native custom element that stacks masked backdrop-blur layers to create a directional progressive blur.

items.name: radial-gallery
items.title: Radial Gallery
items.description: Circular rotating image gallery. Items are evenly spaced around a ring that spins continuously. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

items.name: slideshow
items.title: Slideshow
items.description: Full-bleed image slideshow with parallax slide transitions and thumbnail navigation. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

items.name: split-hover
items.title: Split Hover
items.description: Splits text into characters and animates stacked layers on hover for a seamless swap. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

items.name: split-reveal
items.title: Split Reveal
items.description: Masks text and reveals lines, words, or characters on mount or scroll. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

items.name: stacking-words
items.title: Stacking Words
items.description: Splits text into lines and slides each line's words in from the right on scroll. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

items.name: text-loop
items.title: Text Loop
items.description: Cycles through an array of text strings with a blurred vertical slide transition. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

items.name: text-repel
items.title: Text Repel
items.description: Splits text into words or characters that repel from the pointer. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

items.name: text-scramble
items.title: Text Scramble
items.description: Scrambles characters on hover before settling back to the original text. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

items.name: video-player
items.title: Video Player
items.description: Custom video player with play/pause, a hover-expanding scrubber, mute, and GSAP Flip fullscreen expand animation.

items.name: weight-wave
items.title: Weight Wave
items.description: Hover-reactive text effect that smoothly increases font weight with a falloff across neighboring characters. Requires a variable font.
